subject: general
question: National Poet Ramdhari Singh 'Dinkar' was awarded Jnanpith Award for which of his following works?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Urvashi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ramdhari Singh 'Dinkar' was awarded the Jnanpith Award in **1972** for his notable work titled "Urvashi."
 
• This work is a significant contribution to Hindi literature and showcases his prowess in poetry.
 
• The Jnanpith Award is** one of the highest literary honors in India**, established in **1961 **by the Jnanpith Trust.
 
• It recognizes outstanding contributions to Indian literature in various languages** recognized in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanskriti Ke Chaar Adhyay **is a significant work by Ramdhari Singh 'Dinkar' that explores the four essential aspects of Indian culture: Dharma (righteousness), Artha (wealth), Kama (desire), and Moksha (liberation).
 
• **"Kurukshetra" **is another notable poem by Dinkar that revolves around the epic Mahabharata and the battle of Kurukshetra, which symbolizes the eternal struggle between good and evil.
 
• **"Rashmirathi"** is a celebrated epic poem by Dinkar that narrates the life of Karana, a central character in the Mahabharata, highlighting his struggles, loyalty, and valor.
